title.zh: v2.0.79 冻结轨道头那一列做成真正的实心（上一版只修了一半，且判据本身是错的）
title.en: v2.0.79 The Frozen Header Column Is Actually Solid Now (the Previous Fix Covered Half the Leak, and Its Check Was Wrong)

highlights.zh: 用户复测后报告**仍然侵入**，是对的。v2.0.77 只修了轨道头与网格之间那道 **16px 空隙**，而同一列还有第二处漏光：**轨道头上下两条边条**。实测行高 85px、轨道头盒子只有 **73px**——差的 6px×2 是**行自己的 padding**，在内容盒之外。用「这一列是否实心」的口径一测：**3217/16256 个采样点透出东西**（其中 564 处直接是步进格子）。
highlights.en: The user re-tested and reported it **still intrudes** — correctly. v2.0.77 fixed only the **16 px gutter** between the header and the grid, while the same column had a second leak: the **strips above and below the header box**. Measured: the row is 85 px tall and the header box only **73 px**, so 6 px at each end is the **row's own padding**, outside the content box. Measured with the right question — "is this column solid?" — **3217 of 16256 samples showed something through…

highlights.zh: **我的检查判据本身是错的，这才是真正的问题。** v2.0.77 的探针问的是「这里有没有出现步进格子」，而格子只有 40px、位于 73px 盒子**内部**，根本到不了那 6px 边条——所以它「通过」了一个透光的列，并让我以为修好了。**判据错了比没有判据更糟。** 现在探针断言的是「这一列不许透出东西」，并把采样点分三类：轨道头/图层、**行自己的不透明 padding（合法）**、格子或透明（失败）。
highlights.en: **The real problem was that my check asked the wrong question.** The v2.0.77 probe asked "is a step cell visible here?", and the cells are 40 px tall inside a 73 px box — they can never reach those 6 px strips. So it **passed a leaking column** and convinced me the job was done. **A wrong criterion is worse than none.** The probe now asserts "nothing may show through this column" and classifies each sample: header/layer, **the row's own opaque padding (legitimate)**, or a ce…

highlights.zh: **另外两条实测结论。** ① **`align-self: stretch` 修不了它**：给轨道头加上后实测高度**仍是 73px**——flex 行交叉轴尺寸取自内容盒，而 padding 在内容盒之外，子元素无论怎么拉伸都覆盖不到它。② **`pointer-events: none` 会让探针看不见图层**：`elementFromPoint` 会跳过这类元素，于是图层明明在、探针却报了 3217 处失败。图层现在不加这个属性，因为它不遮挡任何可交互元素（格子正好从它右缘开始，轨道头 z 更高）。
highlights.en: **Two more measured conclusions.** (1) **`align-self: stretch` does not fix it**: with it applied the header still measured **73 px**, because a flex line's cross size comes from the content box and the padding is outside it — no child can stretch into it. (2) **`pointer-events: none` makes a layer invisible to the probe**: `elementFromPoint` skips such elements, so the layer was present while the check reported 3217 failures.
